title: Braking & Pneumatics

canonicalTerminology.definition: An automatic air-brake system uses train-pipe pressure changes and local brake equipment to command braking throughout a train.

claims.text: Railway braking must be treated as a safety-critical system whose performance and inspection limits are governed by applicable vehicle, operational and maintenance requirements.
claims.applicabilityNote: Educational canonical statement. Apply current controlled legislation, standards, manufacturer documentation and organisational procedures where operational decisions are involved.

visualSpecs.purpose: Explain functional brake-command chain without operational settings.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent operational acceptance limits, tolerances, settings or manufacturer-specific values.
Do not present educational diagrams or summaries as approved operating or maintenance instructions.
